title: The motivic Lie algebra embeds into the cohomology of the general linear group
summary: We show that the motivic Lie algebra of mixed Tate motives over $\mathbb{Z}$ embeds canonically into the unstable compactly-supported cohomology of locally symmetric spaces for $\mathrm{GL}_g(\mathbb{Z})$, and into the weight-zero compactly-supported cohomology of $\mathcal{A}_g$, the moduli space of principally polarized abelian varieties. Our construction passes through tropical geometry and graph complexes: compactly-supported analogues of the Borel classes pull back via the tropical Torelli map to canonical graph cocycles.
